**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 107 **Price** 27,000 gp **Ammunition** nine-barrel block (5 gp, L Bulk) --- **Usage** mounted (black powder) **Space** 6 feet long, 4 feet wide, 5 feet high **Crew** 1 to 3 **Proficiency** martial --- **AC** 36 **Fort** +30 **Ref** +22 **Hardness** 15 **HP** 240 **Immunities** object immunities --- **Speed** 20 feet (pulled or pushed) --- Another design originating from a snow-covered land, the volley gun trades the power of black-powder cannons for a high rate of fire at a much smaller caliber. The nine barrels of the volley gun are triggered via a crank, rotating around the central shaft. The weapon is reloaded by slotting a single block placed into the breach, allowing each of the nine barrels to be fired before this mounted gun needs to be reloaded.
**Aim** rotate 45°
**Load** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) 1 time, requires a successful DC 20 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check
**Launch** ([attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540), manipulate) 18d6 piercing, 120-foot [line](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388), DC 35 Reflex
